label: About
title: About Bleached Timber Ant Section
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 225 recent saved-signal files and 82 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Tomasz Pudełko Official: Instagram, Facebook | Linktree and We Shall Not Be Moved, by Audrea Lim, plus 7 more. A source image from scontent-det1-1.cdninstagram.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Bleached Timber Ant Section: Bleached timber observatory-section, architectural section archetype, shallow macro cutaway plate through a weathered slab. Long horizontal plank seams divide four to six pale strata; thin cuts open as source-bearing apertures, with black ant-like nodes compressed at the upper-right edge and a cropped charcoal void... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against upper-right ant-filled torn seam, lower-left black cutaway mouth with cropped ants, and oxblood eroded chamber in right-middle plank.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
